name: Cross-account S3 bucket grant to an external principal
note: IAM-1202: an S3 bucket policy grants a role in account 999988887777 read on the bucket's objects. S3 bucket/object ARNs (arn:aws:s3:::finance-reports/*) carry NO account id, so the analyzer cannot know the bucket owner's account and MUST NOT assert same-vs-cross-account on that missing evidence (a routine same-account grant would otherwise be mislabeled external). The named principal is enumerated distinctly (aws-principal-arn), NEVER collapsed with the resource owner or treated as public, and surfaced as a RESOURCE-CROSS-ACCOUNT (high) finding, but the account relationship is HEDGED as potentially cross-account (undetermined) rather than asserted. The graph still draws an external-principal -> can-access-resource -> attached-resource edge. Not anonymous, so no PUBLIC-ACCESS.

RESOURCE-CROSS-ACCOUNT: does not include an account id
